page_title: PAL 0-2 SEV | Las Palmas v Sevilla 14/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+3' 0 - 2 Goal! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
90+1' Orjan Nyland (Sevilla) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+1' The substitution has been made. Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) has replaced Alex Suarez.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
88' The corner is swung in but Las Palmas can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

88' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Las Palmas can continue in their attacking effort.
87' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Maximo Perrone and he is replaced by Jose Campana (Las Palmas).
86' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
85' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) was too forceful with his tackle and Alejandro Ruiz interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Las Palmas earn a free kick.
84' Marvin (Las Palmas) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a clever chip pass, but one of the defending players comes up with a timely interception.
83' The free kick from long range, taken by Las Palmas, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
81' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) has a goal ruled out for offside!
81' Marvin (Las Palmas) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
80' Marvin (Las Palmas) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
78' The manager makes a subsitution with Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) coming on for Oliver Torres.
78' The game has come to an end for Isaac Romero. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Suso (Sevilla).
78' Substitution. Sandro Ramirez makes his way off the pitch and Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) comes on as his replacement.
78' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Javier Munoz will be replaced by Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
76' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
75' Las Palmas can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
73' This is a yellow card! Kike Salas (Sevilla) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
72' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle and signals a foul after Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) brought his opponent down.
70' Sevilla couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Aaron Escandell (Las Palmas) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
66' Quique Sanchez Flores prepares a substitution. Lucas Ocampos is replaced by Jesus Navas (Sevilla).
66' The referee allows time for a substitution. Loic Bade will be replaced by Lucien Agoume (Sevilla).
66' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
65' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Orjan Nyland to dive and make a save.
64' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Sevilla is cautioned for aggressive play. Las Palmas are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
61' Loic Bade (Sevilla) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
58' That was close. Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
57' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
55' Las Palmas take a short corner kick.
52' A player from Las Palmas commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Free kick. Sevilla will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
49' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.

48' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Alejandro Ruiz blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Sevilla have a free kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Marvin (Las Palmas) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
45+3' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45+3' Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
43' 0 - 1 Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) heads the ball low inside the right post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
43' The referee is firm and issues Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) a deserved yellow card.
42' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Aaron Escandell comes off his line to intercept.
40' Marvin (Las Palmas) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
38' Great teamplay by Las Palmas as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
35' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
33' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
30' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
27' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
26' Oliver Torres (Sevilla) will take a corner kick.
25' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Oliver Torres (Sevilla). The referee blows his whistle, Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.

23' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the left post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
22' Orjan Nyland displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
21' Las Palmas are ruled offside.
19' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
16' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
15' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
12' 70:30 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
10' Sevilla players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
7' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
6' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Saul Coco (Las Palmas). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.

6' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Saul Coco (Las Palmas), but referee Alejandro Ruiz must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
5' The game is interrupted now, Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
3' Saul Coco (Las Palmas) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
2' The ball is cleared after Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Sevilla will take the kick-off.
Alejandro Ruiz will referee today's match.
